content: We have proposed a novel RvNN architecture to fully utilize linguistic priors. A newly introduced tag-level tree-LSTM demonstrates that it can effectively control the composition function of the corresponding word-level tree-LSTM. In addition, the proper contextualization of the input word vectors results in significant performance improvements on several sentence-level tasks. For future work, we plan to explore a new way of exploiting dependency trees effectively, similar to the case of constituency trees.
